title: Rimuru-fied Slimes
description: This resource pack changes slimes, slimeballs/blocks and the slime spawn egg to be Rimuru
body:
This resource pack changes **slimes**, **slime balls**, **slime blocks**, and the **slime spawn egg** to be **Rimuru Tempest** from **That Time I Got Reincarnated As A Slime** (Tensura, TTIGRAAS).

This pack SHOULD work with most versions of minecraft, but no guarantees.

This pack also works with Fresh Animations and Visuality. For Visuality, change the colour of the slime blobs to this; #00d5ff

Fresh Animations:
https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations

Visuality:
https://modrinth.com/mod/visuality

This is my first resource pack, so I hope that you guys enjoy this pack as much as I do!
